skill.title: Axis distance
skill.promise: You can measure distance along one axis.
skill.pipAbility: Pip can measure a straight gap.

lessons.title: Measure one axis

screens.prompt: From x = 1 to x = 6, how far along the axis?

feedback.too_low: Subtract the smaller x from the larger. Move higher.
feedback.too_high: The gap is smaller than that. Move lower.

screens.prompt: From y = 2 to y = 8, how far up the axis?

feedback.too_low: The rise is larger than that. Move higher.
feedback.too_high: The rise is smaller than that. Move lower.

screens.prompt: Distance along an axis counts what?

feedback.wrong_option: A step left and a step right of the same size have the same distance.

screens.correctMessage: Distance is the size of the gap.

feedback.wrong_direction: Stay on the horizontal line. The mark is to the right.
feedback.wrong_length: The direction is right. The gap is 6 units.

screens.prompt: Points (4, 1) and (4, 7) share x. What is the vertical gap?

feedback.too_low: The y numbers are farther apart. Move higher.
feedback.too_high: The y numbers are closer than that. Move lower.

screens.correctMessage: Same x means the whole gap is vertical.

lessons.whyItMatters: Error along one axis is the simplest loss.
